title: Interface-first scanner authority coherence
trace_findings: Production scanner carried a separately injected AST projection authority from the response pipeline's AST projection authority.
Controller inheritance parsing invoked the concrete PHP class-name resolution authority rather than the pipeline's injectable authority.
changes: Scanner AST projection property now delegates to responseSemanticPipeline.astProjection.
Canonical parser receives AST projection and PHP class-name resolution authorities from the same response pipeline dependency contract.
Parent class name resolution now uses the supplied PhpClassNameResolutionRuleInterface.
Scanner interface and judgment contract version advanced from 35 to 36.
Added phase documentation; no new relation/foundation/subscanner layer or semantic authority was introduced.
remaining_gaps: Direct parser compatibility entry points retain concrete defaults.
Other upstream authorities may still compose their own defaults internally.
DTO inventory timing and canonical per-method response product closure remain open.
